name: Funding-OI joint fragility gate — momentum continuation on confirmed positioning (long, 4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: neither funding nor OI alone times reversals, but their JOINT state gates regime. When funding_rate is NEUTRAL (not top-decile, so no crowded-long carry drag) AND open_interest is RISING WITH price (healthy new-money trend), momentum continuation is favored — fresh OI is sustaining the move, not late trend-followers piling in without fuel. We take an ordinary momentum entry (positive ret_Nd + confirmed ADX trend) but ONLY when positioning confirms, riding continuation while the book is healthy and stepping aside when it is not. SPOT long (direction +1), hold ~0.5-1d. DISCONFIRMER 1: kill if the positioning gate does NOT improve a plain momentum baseline on the SAME bars (compare gated vs ungated Sharpe net of fees) — if the funding-neutral + OI-rising filter adds no lift, it is decorative curve-fit. DISCONFIRMER 2: kill if the multi-condition gate fires so rarely it fails effective-N, or if the benefit is entirely from avoiding 1-2 crash days (regime-luck, not repeatable structure).
catalyst: positive momentum + confirmed ADX trend, gated by neutral funding and rising OI — a healthy new-money trend to ride long.
